messages:
Ellen Park: Tom from SkyBox hardware says they want to sign daily usage files and POST a manifest webhook to us. They also want a daily reconciliation report.
Tom (HW Partner): Yes - we can produce gzipped CSVs + manifest.json.sig (ed25519). We need clear failure semantics.
Marcus Li: Key points: hash algorithm sha256, manifest contains file list + row counts, signature over raw manifest bytes. Reject if checksum mismatch.
Hannah Ortiz: Finance rule: if partner-reported vs computed daily usage delta > 1.5% mark for manual review. Also need backfill policy: 60 days default.
BillingBot: Automated check: schema:hw-usage-v1 and sku-map validation. Dry-run results posted to #partnerships-dry-run.
Ellen Park: Dedupe by event_id, dedupe TTL 30d for bulk. Replay job needed for late arrivals - annotate reports with replay_tag.
Marcus Li: Sample error response: {"error":"checksum_mismatch","detail":"file usage-20260320.gz checksum invalid"}
Tom (HW Partner): We'll send a sample gz + sig tomorrow. Can you confirm ingest accepts CSV only?
Hannah Ortiz: Yes CSV for now. Action items: Marcus prepare manifest spec; Ellen coordinate test; Tom share sample. Target dry-run Fri.
